# Rule schema v1 (generated)

<!-- Generated by scripts/learning/genRuleSchema.mjs from src/lib/agents/families/ruleSchema.ts. Do not edit by hand; a test fails when this file is stale. -->

KB-010: a family rule version is a declarative specification; parameters are the only degree of freedom in M6 (a structural change is a new lineage, FAM-101). The loader rejects unknown fields, operators and keys, mixed AND/OR at one level, and parameter values outside their ch.15 bounds.

## Shape

- condition: `{field, op, value}` or `{field, op, param}`; `param` names a Lane-B key of the family.
- group: `{logic: "AND" | "OR", items: [...]}`; groups are explicit, one logic per group.
- count_of: `{count_of: {n: number | {param}, items: [condition, ...]}}`, true when at least n conditions are true.
- actions: `enter`, `exit`, `size`, `gate`; exits are tagged `IS` (intraday stop) or `CS` (close signal).
- operators: `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `==`, `crosses_above`, `crosses_below`.
- universe tiers: U1, U2, U3; regime states: RISK-ON, NEUTRAL, RISK-OFF, SHOCK, unknown.

## Field vocabulary

| Field | Type | Source | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `close_above_sma200` | bool | AGT-030 | Close above SMA(200) |
| `close_above_sma5` | bool | AGT-030 | Close above SMA(5) |
| `new_high_sessions` | number | AGT-030 | Longest window, in sessions, for which today's close is at least the maximum close of the previous sessions (a 250-session high when it is 250 or more) |
| `volume_ratio` | number | AGT-030 | Today's volume divided by the mean volume of the previous 20 sessions |
| `return_6m_top_fraction` | number | AGT-030 | Share of the tier whose 6-month return is at or above this code's (0.2 = top 20 %) |
| `adv_filter_ok` | bool | AGT-030 | The tier ADV and price minimums are met |
| `rsi2` | number | AGT-030 | RSI(2), Wilder |
| `rsi14` | number | AGT-030 | RSI(14), Wilder |
| `day_range_position` | number | AGT-030 | (close - low) / (high - low), 0.5 if high = low |
| `close_above_prior_close` | bool | AGT-030 | Close above the prior close |
| `event_polarity` | number | AGT-020 | Polarity of the event group: -1, 0 or +1 |
| `event_ar_day0_pct` | number | AGT-020 | Day-0 abnormal return, percent |
| `event_volume_ratio_day0` | number | AGT-020 | Day-0 volume ratio |
| `event_age_sessions` | number | AGT-020 | Sessions since day 0 of the event |
| `event_price_sensitive` | bool | AGT-020 | The event is price-sensitive |
| `event_catalyst_results_or_guidance_up` | bool | AGT-020 | The event is a results or guidance-up event |
| `event_qualifies_f3` | bool | AGT-020 | The event is results, contract win, guidance up or takeover target |
| `negative_event_last_3_sessions` | bool | AGT-020 | A negative-polarity event in the last 3 sessions |
| `open_gap_above_day0_close_pct` | number | AGT-020 | Next open above the day-0 close, percent |

| `pe_below_sector_median` | bool | DAT-170 | P/E below the median of its GICS sector |
| `net_debt_ebitda` | number | DAT-170 | Net debt divided by EBITDA |
| `sessions_held` | number | position | Sessions since the entry fill |

```json
        "op": ">=",
        "param": "f5_stop_cap_pct"
      }
    },
    {
      "action": "exit",
      "id": "trailing-stop",
      "kind": "IS",
      "when": {
        "field": "drawdown_atr_from_high_close",
        "op": ">=",
        "param": "f5_trail_atr"
      }
    },
    {
      "action": "exit",
      "id": "volume-dry-up",
      "kind": "CS",
      "when": {
        "field": "volume_ratio_dry_up_sessions",
        "op": ">=",
        "value": 3
      }
    },
    {
      "action": "exit",
      "id": "negative-event",
      "kind": "CS",
      "when": {
        "field": "negative_event_since_entry",
        "op": "==",
        "value": true
      }
    },
    {
      "action": "exit",
      "id": "time-exit",
      "kind": "CS",
      "when": {
        "field": "sessions_held",
        "op": ">=",
        "param": "f5_time_stop"
      }
    },
    {
      "action": "size",
      "rule": "FAM-001",
      "half_size_regimes": []
    }
  ],
  "rank": {
    "field": "volume_ratio",
    "order": "desc"
  }
}
```

### F6

Universe: U1, U2. Rank: `class_insider_score` desc.

| Key | Default | Bounds | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `event_polarity_threshold_pct` | 2 | 0.5 to 10 | % |
| `f6_insider_min` | 0.5 | 0.25 to 0.75 | score |
| `f6_min_classes` | 3 | 3 to 4 | classes |
| `f6_short_drop_pp` | 2 | 1 to 4 | pp |
| `f6_stop_atr` | 2 | 1.5 to 3 | x ATR |
| `f6_time_stop` | 20 | 10 to 40 | sessions |
| `insider_score_weights` | {"director_net":0.5,"holder_new_or_increase":0.25,"holder_decrease":0.25} | object | score |
| `insider_window_sessions` | 30 | 10 to 60 | sessions |
| `reentry_block` | 10 | 5 to 20 | sessions |
